user.title: Add a mosque
user.description: Choose a stable mosque ID (lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens). After setup, open Configure to import a CSV timetable.

error.invalid_mosque_id: Enter 1–64 lowercase letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
error.invalid_name: Enter a mosque name of 1–100 characters.

abort.already_configured: This mosque ID is already configured.

import_csv.title: Upload a CSV timetable
import_csv.description:
Upload a UTF-8 CSV, at most 512 KiB, with a header row and ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the chosen year. Annual imports may be incomplete; missing dates and fields remain unavailable. Ramadan imports are stored separately; activation is not implemented yet.

{detail}

map_columns.title: Map CSV columns
map_columns.description:
Select the date column and the source column for each published prayer field. Leave unpublished fields unselected. Each column can be mapped only once. Recognized headings are suggested; check every choice. Times require HH:MM (24-hour) or HH:MM AM/PM as selected. Jumu’ah congregations may use semicolon-separated times.

{detail}

error.invalid_csv: The CSV could not be validated. See the details above.
error.invalid_mapping: Select at least one prayer column. A source column cannot be reused or mapped as both a date and a prayer.
error.save_failed: Saving failed. The active timetable has not been replaced. Try again after checking Home Assistant storage and logs.

abort.integration_not_loaded: The mosque integration must be loaded before importing. Check its setup error or change its settings first.
abort.pending_import_exists: Review or reject the pending import before uploading another file.
abort.upload_expired: The upload is no longer available. Start a new CSV import.
abort.no_pending_import: There is no pending timetable to review.
abort.stale_import: The pending import changed while you were reviewing it. Reopen Configure and review the current import.
abort.integration_reloaded: Mosque settings changed while this dialog was open. Reopen Configure to review the current timetable.

options.reject: Reject and keep the active timetable
